defects.severity: real, renderer-side (frozen binary; not fixable from a spec)
defects.title: frame-0 dots start one cell downstream of the first drawn route cell after the border port
defects.check_reading: origins: 6/6 routes start at their arrow origin (evidence/v1/check.txt) - the check's definition is dot_cells[0] == origin_cell(), and origin_cell() is the polyline's first point plus one step, while the polyline's first point is already the first cell outside the border.
defects.capture_reading: For all six routes the frame-0 dot sits at port row + 2 while the first drawn route cell is at port row + 1 (evidence/v1/v1-77x47-frames.txt frame 0): cli->api port (37,4), first drawn (37,5), dot (37,6); api->auth port (33,12), first drawn (33,13), dot (33,14); api->queue port (35,12), first drawn (35,13), dot (35,14); queue->worker port (38,26), first drawn (38,27), dot (38,28); auth->db port (29,26), first drawn (29,27), dot (29,28); worker->db port (36,34), first drawn (36,35), dot (36,36).
defects.conclusion: the check and the capture disagree about the arrow origin; under the stated rule (first drawn cell after the border port) the dots start one cell late. Both readings are recorded; the spec cannot fix it.

defects.title: no group regions in this view
defects.detail: the source's semantic-tier shades are unmet because sibling group regions on this centred 5-rank chain render as bands outside their members (attempts/01-lr-synthetic-groups). Recorded rather than shipping false regions; groups line in evidence/v1/check.txt is empty.

defects.title: pane rectangle not recorded by the evidence script
defects.detail: scripts/viz-evidence.sh resolves the pane rectangle with `herdr pane layout` (no --pane/--current), which returned the FOCUSED tab (w7G:t1) rather than this session's tab (w7E:t7D), so manifest pane_rect and pane_cols are null and pane_rows came from the scroll viewport. The measured size therefore comes from the app's own header token 83x51 @100% (evidence/v1/v1-text.txt line 1), and fit is proven by the pinned 77x47 dump of the final spec.

defects.title: pane frames capture truncated to frames 17-35
defects.detail: herdr returns at most 1000 lines per pane read, so evidence/v1/v1-frames.txt holds only the last 19 of 36 frames (all timestamped). The full lap including frame 0 is the pinned dump evidence/v1/v1-77x47-frames.txt (36 frames, 0..35).

blockers: No renderer capability is missing for the structure the source states; the only unmet capability is honest tier regions on a centred chain (D2), which the frozen engine cannot place without drawing boxes outside their members.
